items.title: Cisco Grows Into Its Multiple, And The Market Has To Do The Rest
items.summary: Consensus has the earnings arriving, and the multiple falling, yet the scenario that follows leaves a holder within a few percent of today's price unless the market goes on paying a richer forward multiple than it does today.

items.title: Forget Nvidia. Cisco Could Be a Hidden Winner From the AI Boom
items.summary: Nvidia grabs the AI headlines, but a 69% gain over the past year hints that a quieter networking giant may be capturing just as much of the buildout. The question is whether Cisco's biggest surge is still ahead or already priced in.

items.summary: OKTA's Q2 earnings are likely to benefit from AI product demand, strong RPO growth and new partnerships, offset by competition and cautious IT spending.

items.title: Workday to Report Q2 Earnings: Can Strong Revenues Drive Growth?

items.title: Super Micro Sinks 7% as Taiwan Indicts Employees Over Illegal AI Server Exports to China, Dell Slips
items.summary: Taiwanese prosecutors just indicted employees tied to an AI server smuggling ring stretching from Taiwan to China through three transit countries, and one major US chip stock is taking a disproportionate hit while its closest rivals barely flinch.
